name: How long does it take to install molding in a standard room?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install molding in a standard room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of molding installation depends on the type of molding, room size, and the installer's experience. For a standard 12x12 foot room, installing baseboards might take a professional a few hours, while crown molding, which requires more precision, could take a full day. If existing molding needs removal, or if the walls require prep work, the timeline will extend. Multiple rooms or complex designs with many corners or varied angles will naturally take longer. A typical whole-house project might span several days.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing molding in a standard room can take from a few hours for baseboards to a full day for crown molding, depending on complexity and room size.
